violations.why: Main reads var1 twice; the priority-6 compute ISR can preempt between them and write it, so the two reads may see different values.
Main reads var2 twice; the compute ISR can preempt between the reads and write var2.
The RR ISR writes the element and later reads it. The higher-priority compute ISR can preempt between those accesses and overwrite it.
The compute ISR can preempt the RR ISR after it writes RT_h and overwrite it, so the later read sees the wrong value.
The compute ISR can preempt the RR ISR between its write and read of RT4 and overwrite the value.
